notes:
Account background: - Mid-size healthcare payments processor supporting hospital billing + virtual care lines. Heavy PHI + card data flow; security/compliance first. - Mature Contact Center (Genesys) + Zendesk ticketing; ~1,200 agents across NA. - Current pain: agent context switching, long AHT on refunds/insurance claims, latency-related UI timeouts during promo spikes.

Use-case summary: - Primary: agent assist (real-time snippets, suggested responses, tool-calls into internal systems). - Secondary: ticket summarization + auto-triage for lvl-1, reranking of KB results. - Must survive seasonal spikes (billing cycles) and Black Friday-like promos for partner pharmacies: target p95 latency <300ms for assist path, ability to sustain 2k RPS burst for 3-5 minutes without degradation.

Security/compliance needs: - VPC-only deployment preferred (no egress of raw PHI outside tenant). - Long-term retention controls: legal requests require 6+ years of audit logs and text retention; retention controls configurable per-route. - Audit logging + KMS/HSM for key management, SSO/SAML, SCIM integration for provisioning.

Notes from discovery/demo calls: - 2026-02-10 discovery call w/ Marissa, Diego, SentryCare infra + security: they asked "Can we pin to a FIPS-validated cipher and HSM-backed keys?"; response: private + KMS/HSM options, need to confirm FIPS specifics. - 2026-02-24 product demo: showed tool-calling prototype (3rd-party CRM update via webhook). Client wants server-side tool-calls with explicit allowlist and audit trail. - 2026-03-02 spike test scoping call (fireflies ff-2026-03-02-07b2c1): agreed POC will include a synthetic load test to 2k RPS and soak for 10 minutes.

POC plan and success metrics: - 6-week POC in VPC with mirrored traffic (sampling 5-10% of live). - Deliverables: latency reports (p50/p95/p99), token-level cost estimates, regression alerts on summary quality (ROUGE/semantic eval sets). - Success criteria: p95 <300ms for agent_assist; accuracy for summarization > 85% on internal eval set; zero PHI leakage in red-team run.

Technical notes / constraints: - Network: require VPC peering + strict egress rules; SentryCare uses dedicated transit VPCs and will require NAT restrictions. - Data residency: logs + transcripts must remain in us-east-1 and be export controlled. - Integrations: Genesys --> Redwood proxy for streaming; Zendesk for post-ticket summaries + evidence attachments. - Fallback policy: must support local on-prem model fallback if private cluster degraded.

Sales/ops timeline & stakeholders: - Procurement/Legal engaged (SentryCare legal lead: Anna Moreno). - Security review to run week of 2026-03-22 (expect SC gating items: DPA PHI addendum, network diagram, penetration test report). - Budget: estimated ARR in range 75k-250k; procurement process expected to take 6-8 weeks after legal sign-off.

Open items / questions: - Exact FIPS/HSM certification requirement (client asked for FIPS-140-2/3 confirmation). - Retention policy granularity: need per-route retention TTL and secure deletion timeframe. - Can Redwood provide a signed SOC2 + HITRUST letter for private deployment?
